hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
Let part3 be part 3 of the enemy.
Let list2 be [].
If part2 is dead, then
  Count up "tawrichDeadTurn".
  If not the register's 'hasTawrichDeadDeformDone', then
    Append 2 to list2.
    Set the register's 'hasTawrichDeadDeformDone' to true.
If part3 is dead, then
  Count up "zarichDeadTurn".
  If not the register's 'hasZarichDeadDeformDone', then
    Append 3 to list2.
    Set the register's 'hasZarichDeadDeformDone' to true.
If list2 is not empty, then part uses the built-in move DEFORM immediately with options {deformTag: "deformation_01", filteringDeformPosArray: list2} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
Let paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs be the form for part under the phases list.
If paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs is not the current form of part, then
  Part changes to form paramSuffixNoWithBpConfs.
  Part cancels its cast.
If part3 is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of part3.
  If the register's 'zarichMultipleAbilityMap' at ability is missing, then part3 uses ability.
  Otherwise, part3 uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityTag: the register's 'zarichMultipleAbilityMap' at ability, abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect}].
If part is ready to act, then
  Let number be the numeric entry "turn_for_araise" in the battle settings of the enemy.
  If the count "tawrichDeadTurn" is at least number or the count "zarichDeadTurn" is at least number, then choose state 12 next and stop.
  Part picks and uses a smart-weighted move.

hooks.logic:
Let v be nothing.
Let number be the numeric entry "turn_for_araise" in the battle settings of the acting enemy.
Let list2 be [].
If the count "tawrichDeadTurn" is at least number, then
  Set v to 2.
  Set the register's 'hasTawrichDeadDeformDone' to false.
  Reset the count "tawrichDeadTurn".
  Set list2 to [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_MAGIC_V2 status, the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_NINJUTSU status], saChildNos: [v]}].
Otherwise, if the count "zarichDeadTurn" is at least number, then
  Set v to 3.
  Set the register's 'hasZarichDeadDeformDone' to false.
  Reset the count "zarichDeadTurn".
  Set list2 to [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the ADJUST_DAMAGE_ZERO_PHYSICAL_V2 status, saChildNos: [v]}].
Queue the move {abilityTag: "araise", abilityOptions: {id: 1, forceTargets: [part v of the acting enemy]}}.
Let v2 be a revive sequence {nos: [v], deformTag: "deformation_02", filteringDeformPosArray: [v, 1], shouldReset: true}.
Append [{builtin: "RESET", resetChildNos: [1]}] to v2.
Append list2 to v2.
Queue the pose-change sequence v2.
Put queued moves ahead of counters.
